// Synthetic ambient dialogue. No game assets, lore or external source files are required.
export const AMBIENT_LINE_MAX = 96;
export const KINDS = Object.freeze(['observation', 'quip', 'hum']);
export const PLACES = Object.freeze(['hall', 'desk']);
export const STAGES = Object.freeze(['opening', 'closing']);
export const NEAR_TAGS = Object.freeze(['visitor', 'display']);
const person = (id, name, role, appears) => Object.freeze({ id, name, role, kind: 'character', portrait: id, voice: `${id}-voice`, appears });
export const SPEAKERS = Object.freeze({
  guide: person('guide', 'Guide', 'Exhibit guide', [{ place: 'hall', stages: ['opening', 'closing'] }]),
  operator: person('operator', 'Operator', 'Desk operator', [{ place: 'desk', stages: ['opening'] }])
});
const L = (id, kind, text, tags = {}) => Object.freeze({ id, kind, text, ...tags });
const f = (flag, is) => (is === undefined ? { flag } : { flag, is });
export const POOLS = Object.freeze({
  guide: Object.freeze([
    L('guide-greeting', 'observation', 'The next tour begins here.', { near: 'visitor' }),
    L('guide-map', 'observation', 'A fresh map is on the desk.', { places: ['hall'], stages: ['opening'] }),
    L('guide-quiet', 'hum', 'Hm hm hmm.', { mood: 'quiet' }),
    L('guide-open', 'observation', 'The side room is ready.', { when: f('roomOpen') }),
    L('guide-check', 'observation', 'Please wait while we check.', { when: { all: [f('arrived'), f('checked', false)] } })
  ]),
  operator: Object.freeze([
    L('operator-sign', 'observation', 'The sign points toward the hall.', { near: 'display', places: ['desk'] }),
    L('operator-hours', 'observation', 'We close in ten minutes.', { stages: ['closing'] }),
    L('operator-order', 'quip', 'These maps are finally in order.')
  ])
});
const X = (id, a, b, first, second, tags = {}) => Object.freeze({ id, a, b, lines: Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ speaker: a, text: first }), Object.freeze({ speaker: b, text: second })]), ...tags });
export const EXCHANGES = Object.freeze([
  X('x-map-check', 'guide', 'operator', 'Are the maps ready?', 'Yes, beside the desk.'),
  X('x-close-check', 'operator', 'guide', 'Shall I put the maps away?', 'Leave one for the last visitor.', { stages: ['closing'], when: f('lastTour') })
]);
